description: Turn a program's incoming requests on or off. On creates the program's "Incoming Requests" initiative, where requests filed into the program (and requests other programs forward or route to it) wait for its lead to approve and route them. Off stops new filings; the requests already waiting are left alone. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can edit programs.

enabled.description: true to take incoming requests, false to stop.

name: anyforge_set_program_request_intake
title: Set program request intake
